articles.title: Arkansas Teen Sailor Killed At Pearl Harbor Will Finally Be Laid To Rest After Nearly 85 Years
articles.summary: The remains of an Arkansas teenager, Fireman 3rd Class, who perished aboard a battleship during the Pearl Harbor attack in 1941, are finally returning home for burial after nearly 85 years. The U.S. Navy is facilitating the interment, providing long-awaited closure and honoring a serviceman lost in one of America's defining historical military engagements. This highlights the nation's enduring commitment to its fallen heroes.
